pokedexEntries.rb: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

pokedexEntries.ye: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is melted inside by strong acids.

pokedexEntries.go: Even though it is filled with ACID, it does not melt because it also oozes a neutralizing fluid.

pokedexEntries.si: If its prey is bigger than its mouth, it slices up the victim with sharp leaves, then eats every morsel.

pokedexEntries.cr: When it’s hungry, it swings its razor-sharp leaves, slicing up any unlucky object nearby for food.

pokedexEntries.rs: WEEPINBELL has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the POKéMON hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.

pokedexEntries.fr: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

pokedexEntries.lg: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

pokedexEntries.em: At night, a WEEPINBELL hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.

pokedexEntries.dpp: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.

pokedexEntries.hg: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.
